caption: The drawing depicts a single standing puppet or doll centered on a plain, beige background. The puppet has a detailed face with pronounced wrinkles, red and brown shading, and white hair that is styled upwards. The face has red cheeks, marked lines, and blue around the eyes. The puppet is dressed in a long, patchwork garment made up of interwoven strips of fabric in various colors, including green, yellow, orange, red, blue, and brown, creating a colorful, woven pattern throughout the clothing. Both arms are visible and extend outward from the body; the left arm is angled slightly downward and the right arm is bent at the elbow. The sleeves are decorated with ruffles and light green accents. The puppet’s collar is wide and ruffled with hints of yellow and off-white, and there are some additional decorative elements near the shoulders, including a small yellow bell tied with a ribbon. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name “Lilith Stahl.” There are no other objects or details present in the composition apart from the puppet and the plain background.
title: Clown Hand Puppet
